# Application settings {#sec-settings-reference}

These are `set` variables, with defaults taken directly from the application.
The table describes startup defaults, not the values of a customised running
session. `:set NAME?` reports the current value. Boolean values accept `on`
or `off`, and the enabling, disabling and toggling forms described in
@sec-customisation.

The track's Grid, Length, input/output routing and playback transforms are
track properties. Recording mode, metronome and count-in belong to the song.
They are deliberately absent from this application-settings table.
